about_description: Nevil Krishna K is a full stack developer in Thrissur, Kerala with 3 years in the React and Next.js ecosystem. He builds web apps, websites, dashboards and mobile apps for clients across Kerala and India, works in TypeScript, Kotlin and Python, and publishes open-source tools, including TMPlayer, an Android TV app with 241 GitHub stars and 24.4K downloads. Also a frontend developer, software engineer and React Native developer, in English, Malayalam, Hindi and Tamil.
